1. [USER] User asked about the difference between role level, application permission, and security role.
2. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Role level security restricts access to data at the row or record level based on a user's role.
3. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Application permissions provide access to functionality across the entire application, regardless of the data being accessed.
4. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Security roles control access to data and functionality within the application and can be customized to meet organizational needs.
5. [ASSISTANT_SAID] In summary, role level security controls access to data at the record level, application permissions control access to functionality, and security roles control access to both data and functionality.
